description: This file defines the 'LuceneSearchEngine' class which extends a SearchEngine for performing searches using Lucene in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for searching, caching, and processing search hits, and references external components like BeanFactory, SecurityGroup, and SearchQuery.

classes.name: LuceneSearchEngine
classes.description: A search engine implementation utilizing Lucene for indexing and querying CRM records, with caching and access control features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Lucene index by retrieving it from BeanFactory.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search query, handles timing, and returns structured search results with total hits and elapsed time.

methods.name: runLucene
methods.description: Performs the actual Lucene search, utilizing cache if available and valid.

methods.name: validateCacheStructure
methods.description: Validates the structure of cached search results to ensure they are properly formed.

methods.name: newHit
methods.description: Queries the Lucene index for hits matching the search string, and filters results based on access permissions.

methods.name: parseHits
methods.description: Processes Lucene hits into a structured set of results, paginated and with total counts.

methods.name: cacheQuery
methods.description: Stores search results in cache for quick retrieval in future searches.
